cases.input: format the docs in /home/diogo/dev/library-docs/docs_unslothai for AI consumption
optimize this library-docs folder for agent reading, obsidian style
compress these docs to be token dense without losing info
cases.rationale: 'compress' + 'token dense' + 'without losing info' = the skill's core promise.

cases.input: organize the docs in this folder by category
cases.rationale: No format/optimize/compress signal — this belongs to organize-docs-skill.

cases.input: rewrite this single README to be shorter
cases.rationale: No folder / metadata.json context — single-file rewrite doesn't need batching.

cases.scenario: Folder exists but has no metadata.json
cases.expected_behavior: setup.sh exits non-zero with clear message; skill tells user to run organize-docs-skill first.

cases.scenario: Folder has nnn-readme.md that looks like an index (lots of links to siblings)
cases.expected_behavior: triage.py keeps it; optimization pass compresses it instead.

cases.scenario: Folder has README.md whose body is dominated by links to numbered siblings
cases.expected_behavior: triage.py flags it as duplicate-index; --apply removes file + metadata entry.

cases.scenario: Re-run skill on a folder where every file has 'optimized: true'
cases.expected_behavior: plan_batches.py returns total_pending: 0; Phase 2 skipped; Phase 3 + 4 + 5 still run cleanly.

cases.scenario: All files in 'Changelog & Releases' deleted by triage
cases.expected_behavior: regenerate_index.py omits the empty H3 section; categories count in frontmatter decremented.

cases.scenario: Agent writes [[004-deleted-file|text]] in 005-foo.md, then 004 is removed
cases.expected_behavior: verify.sh reports BROKEN-WIKILINK; dispatcher reverts the wikilink in 005-foo.md.
